def smooth_resample(knots, step_px=0.40):
    p=np.asarray(knots,dtype=float)
    ds=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1))]
    cs=[CubicSpline(ds,p[:,j],bc_type='natural') for j in range(2)]
    tt=np.arange(0,ds[-1],step_px)
    if tt[-1] < ds[-1]: tt=np.r_[tt,ds[-1]]
    return np.stack([c(tt) for c in cs],1)

def make_paths(mask):
    dt=distance_transform_edt(mask)
    out=[]
    for wi,knots in enumerate(WAYPOINTS):
        uv=smooth_resample(knots)

        rad=map_coordinates(dt,[uv[:,1],uv[:,0]],order=1,mode='nearest')
        # Reduce radius at path locations where hand-fitted centerline is a little off the exact medial axis.
